claims.content: The customer places a bid on a specific auction item using either a SmartBid (maximum automatic bidding) or a Single Bid, receives a confirmation popup to verify the bid amount and payment method, and upon confirmation, the bid is submitted and the customer remains on the product details page.

goal.raw_text: The customer places a bid on a specific auction item using either a SmartBid (maximum automatic bidding) or a Single Bid, receives a confirmation popup to verify the bid amount and payment method, and upon confirmation, the bid is submitted and the customer remains on the product details page.

claims.content: Customer
The customer is viewing a Product Details Page for an auction item that has not yet closed (i.e., 'Time Remaining' is displayed and the auction status is not 'Closed').
The customer has a registered payment method on file, as indicated by the bid confirmation popup referencing a credit card ending in specific digits.
The customer is logged into their account, as evidenced by the presence of personalized navigation links such as 'My Current Bids', 'My Watch List', and 'My Account' in the page header.
The customer clicks the 'Place SmartBid', 'Place Single Bid', or 'QuickBid Now' button on the Product Details Page of an active auction item.

trigger.raw_text: The customer clicks the 'Place SmartBid', 'Place Single Bid', or 'QuickBid Now' button on the Product Details Page of an active auction item.

claims.content: The customer enters a desired bid amount in the 'Your SmartBid' or 'Your Single Bid' field on the Product Details Page.
The customer clicks the 'Place SmartBid' or 'Place Single Bid' button corresponding to their chosen bid type.
A bid confirmation popup appears, displaying the bid amount, bid type (e.g., SmartBid), and the payment method (credit card ending in specific digits), asking 'Is this correct?'.
The customer clicks the 'Yes, Place SmartBid' (or equivalent confirmation) button in the popup to verify and submit the bid.
Upon confirmation, the bid is submitted, the popup closes, and the customer remains on the Product Details Page.
If the customer is not signed in when attempting to place a bid, the system redirects them directly to the sign-in page before allowing the bid to proceed.
If the customer lacks required minimum information to bid, the system returns them to the product details page after they provide the necessary information.
In the bid confirmation popup, the customer may click 'CANCEL' instead of confirming, which aborts the bid submission and keeps them on the product details page.
The customer remains on the Product Details Page after confirming their bid.
The submitted bid is recorded and displayed in the Item Bid History section of the Product Details Page, including bidder name, amount, date/time placed, and SmartBid indicator if applicable.
The system updates the Current High Bid and Time Remaining dynamically on the Product Details Page following a successful bid submission.
